formal_termination_argument.domain: finite valid oriented signed planar diagrams
formal_termination_argument.resource_boundary: worst-case time and storage are exponential; resource exhaustion aborts report production and is never converted into certification
formal_termination_argument.smoothing_branch: oriented smoothing removes exactly one crossing, so crossing_count strictly decreases regardless of the child bad-crossing count
formal_termination_argument.switch_branch: switching the first under-first crossing preserves crossing_count and oriented traversal while reducing bad_crossing_count by one
formal_termination_argument.terminal: bad_crossing_count=0 is a descending diagram and therefore an unlink; all free circles are included in component_count
formal_termination_argument.well_foundedness: the lexicographic order on N x N is well founded; every work-list dependency terminates at a descending unlink
